restaurantName: Le Comptoir de la Mère Germaine
bio: This offshoot of the star establishment doesn’t do things by halves: wood prevails in the contemporary interior and an imposing counter-cum-kitchen with a gleaming spit-roast oven and a shaded terrace. A bistronomic lineup strewn with South American notes....
pageTitle: Le Comptoir de la Mère Germaine
